prompt: Summarise the cause of the Unit 3 trip on 14 March.
completion: A lube-oil pressure transmitter drifted low and tripped the turbine on a false low-pressure signal. The transmitter was replaced and the unit returned to service in eleven hours.

prompt: Write a maintenance note for the feedwater pump seal replacement.
completion: Feedwater pump 2B seal replaced during the scheduled outage window. Vibration returned to baseline. No follow-up action required before the next inspection interval.

prompt: Classify this message by urgency: transformer oil sample shows elevated dissolved gas.
